text:
alex: Heads upwe're proposing a small API change: rename route header from `X-RW-Route` -> `X-RW-Route-Id` and add an optional `X-RW-Quota` header that carries per-request quota tokens like `q=acq:5;burst:2`. Need SDK fallout analysis.

lina: Why rename? what's the benefit vs a compat alias?

alex: Two reasons: (1) disambiguate route *id* vs route *name* so Console can present consistent keys, (2) make it explicit for header parsing libraries (less guessing). We'll accept the old header for ~3 months but want a clean name in logs/telemetry.

sam: For TypeScript SDK this is a breaking change if we switch the default header name. But we can ship a minor that accepts both names and deprecates the old one in logs. If we change the client default in a major bump we need to warn users.

lina: Python/Go can be non-breaking: add support for new header but keep sending old header until a flagged major bump. Add a runtime toggle in clients `client.config.headers.routeKey = 'auto|legacy|id'`.

noah: Quota header: what's the schema? compact k=v pairs? JSON?

alex: Compact k=v;semi-colon feels best for wire. Example: `X-RW-Quota: q=100;burst=10;policy=dedicated`. Server will parse into quota labels for billing and console.

mira: Telemetry: we need to attach `route.id` and `quota.policy` fields to each request event. Also add a sampled tag `quota.evaluate=true` for traces we analyze. We'll need SDK changes to surface those tags to observability libs or auto-instrumentation.

sam: TS SDK: small plan: (1) add tolerant parser accepting both header keys (minor), (2) expose `client.options.routeHeader` for control (minor), (3) in next major flip default and emit console WARN on startup for old default. Also add tests for server accepting both headers.

lina: Go/Py action: add parser + env var fallback `RW_ROUTE_KEY` so ops can flip per-deployment without code changes.

noah: Concern: some proxy layers (nginx, cloudfront) will uppercase/normalize headers. Are we okay with hyphenated name?

alex: Yes hyphens are fine. We'll publish a compatibility note: proxies may convert to `X_RW_ROUTE_ID` in env. Server should canonicalize header names.

mira: Console UX: show both `route.name` and `route.id` columns during migration and provide a mapping view. Also add a small banner during rollout explaining deprecated header.

sam: We should add telemetry mapping table in the SDK CHANGELOG and Console docs: e.g., `X-RW-Route-Id -> event.route.id`, `X-RW-Quota(q) -> event.quota.request_count`.

lina: Testing: create integration test that sends both headers and asserts server picks `X-RW-Route-Id` preferentially but logs acceptance of legacy header (metric: route.header.legacy_accepted=1).

alex: Perf: header size tiny so fine. Quota header capped to 1KB. If client tries to send more, server will drop extras and add `quota.truncated=true` to telemetry.

mira: Also add a telemetry sample rate for quota evaluation (default 1%). We'll include a `quota.sample` boolean in trace tags.

sam: Docs snippet for TS: `client = new RedwoodClient({ headers: { route: '\\${routeId}' }}) // or set routeHeader: 'id'` keep it short. For Py/Go similar examples.

lina: Rollout plan: 1) Draft spec + docs 2) Ship tolerant parsers in all SDKs (minor) 3) Console shows mapping and banner 4) After 90 days flip server canonicalization and start deprecating old header.

alex: Action items: alex -> spec PR; sam -> TS change + deprecation banner; lina -> Py/Go parsers + env toggle; mira -> telemetry mapping + sample rate; noah -> integration test for proxy header normalization.

sdk-bot: Reminder created: RFC-6723 (route-header-quota) and CI job `route-header-compat` scheduled.

alex: Thanks. If folks can ack on timelines (roughly 2w for parsers, 4w for TS default flip readiness) I'll lock the migration window.

mira: Ack to 2w/4w.

sam: Ack. I'll open the TS PR tonight and add feature flag to testbed.

alex: Great closing the loop here. We'll track in the RFC and Console rollout board. :party_parrot:
